abstract: Blini is a tool for quick lookup of nucleotide sequences in databases, and for quick dereplication of sequence collections. It is meant to help clean and characterize large collections of assembled contigs or long sequences that would otherwise be too big to search with online tools, or too demanding for a local machine to process. Benchmarks on simulated data demonstrate that it is faster than existing tools and requires less RAM, while preserving search and clustering accuracy.
